settings.rewards.title: Reward catalogue
settings.rewards.intro: Rewards are what members get for their stamps or points: a free item, a percentage off, an amount off or an upgrade. Managers of every store draft them; only an owner of every store approves. An approved reward can be activated once every store in its scope has its POS rail set up.
settings.rewards.demo: The demo shows a sample reward catalogue, read only. With real data, owners and managers of every store draft rewards here; the owner approves.
settings.rewards.readOnly.role: You can only view the reward catalogue. Only owners and managers of every store can draft rewards; only the owner approves.
settings.rewards.readOnly.scope: You manage some stores, so you can only view the reward catalogue. Rewards apply to the whole chain; only an owner or a manager of every store can draft them.
settings.rewards.noProgramme: There is no loyalty programme yet. Create one on the Programme tab before adding rewards.
settings.rewards.empty: No rewards yet. Add a reward so members can exchange stamps or points for it.
settings.rewards.approval.byOwner: The owner approved it at {time} on {date}.
settings.rewards.approval.bySystem: Approved when the catalogue was loaded, at {time} on {date}.
settings.rewards.approval.retired: The reward is retired and can no longer be redeemed.
settings.rewards.ownerApproves.owner: As an owner of every store you can approve rewards. Each time you change the terms, the reward is approved again on the new terms.
settings.rewards.ownerApproves.other: Only an owner of every store can approve rewards. Managers draft rewards and activate approved ones.
settings.rewards.activation.blocked: Not ready to activate: {stores} not ready yet. Every store in scope needs an active reward rail, and this reward must be mapped to a discount or a 0-price item on the POS.
settings.rewards.retiredNote: A retired reward cannot be reopened. Create a new one if needed.
settings.rewards.retireConfirm: Retire this reward? Members will no longer be able to redeem it and it cannot be reopened.
settings.rewards.backToDraft: You are changing the terms of an approved reward. When you save, it goes back to draft and waits for the owner's approval again.
settings.rewards.name.label: Reward name
settings.rewards.name.hint: Members see this name in the app.
settings.rewards.key.label: Reward code
settings.rewards.key.hint: Lower-case letters without accents, digits and hyphens; it links the reward to a discount on the POS.
settings.rewards.programme.label: Programme
settings.rewards.description.label: Description
settings.rewards.kind.label: Reward type
settings.rewards.kind.noCash: There is no cash payout, top-up or stored-value type.
settings.rewards.kind.free_item.hint: The member gets an item for free.
settings.rewards.kind.percent_off.hint: A percentage off the bill or off the chosen items.
settings.rewards.kind.amount_off.hint: An amount off a bill of at least the minimum.
settings.rewards.kind.free_upgrade.hint: The member gets a larger size or an extra topping for free.
settings.rewards.percent.label: Discount
settings.rewards.amount.label: Amount off
settings.rewards.cap.percentHint: At most {cap} of the price it reduces ({basis}).
settings.rewards.cap.amountHint: At most {cap} of the minimum bill ({basis}).
settings.rewards.cap.gift: Free items and upgrades are gifts; they do not reduce a selling price, so the discount cap does not apply.
settings.rewards.items.givenHint: Choose at least one item, at most {max}.
settings.rewards.items.discountedHint: Leave empty for the whole bill; at most {max} items.
settings.rewards.items.excludedHint: Items this reward never discounts; at most {max} items.
settings.rewards.items.placeholder: Type an item name or code
settings.rewards.costStamps.label: Stamps
settings.rewards.costPoints.label: Points
settings.rewards.cost.hint: Enter stamps, points or both; at least one above 0.
settings.rewards.minBill.label: Minimum bill
settings.rewards.minBill.hint: Leave 0 when no minimum bill is needed.
settings.rewards.minBill.amountHint: Required for an amount off: the amount is checked against this bill.
settings.rewards.validFrom.label: Valid from
settings.rewards.validFrom.hint: Leave empty to start when activated.
settings.rewards.validUntil.label: Valid until
settings.rewards.validUntil.hint: Leave empty for no end date.
settings.rewards.validDays.label: Valid after redeeming
settings.rewards.validDays.hint: How many days a member keeps the reward after redeeming it.
settings.rewards.holdHours.label: Code hold
settings.rewards.holdHours.hint: A code not used within this time gives the stamps and points back.
settings.rewards.perMemberLimit.label: Times per member
settings.rewards.stores.label: Stores
settings.rewards.rails.intro: A reward can be activated only when every store in its scope has an active reward rail and this reward is mapped to a discount or a 0-price item on the POS.
settings.rewards.rails.ready: Every store in scope is ready.
settings.rewards.rails.notReady: {count} store(s) not ready, so the reward cannot be activated yet.
settings.rewards.rails.noMapping: Not mapped to a POS discount yet
settings.rewards.error.plainText: Use plain letters, digits and punctuation only.
settings.rewards.error.keyShape: Use lower-case letters without accents, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters.
settings.rewards.error.duplicateKey: The programme already has a reward with this code.
settings.rewards.error.itemsRequired: Choose at least one item to give.
settings.rewards.error.tooManyItems: The list has too many items.
settings.rewards.error.itemId: Each item is a POS item code of 1 to 100 characters.
settings.rewards.error.itemOverlap: An item cannot be both included and excluded.
settings.rewards.error.untilBeforeFrom: The end date must be on or after the start date.
settings.rewards.error.minBillRequired: An amount off needs a minimum bill above 0 so the discount cap can be checked.
settings.rewards.error.cap: Above the cap of {cap} of the price it reduces ({basis}). This reward cannot be saved.
settings.rewards.error.amountCap: Above the cap of {cap} of the minimum bill, that is {max} ({basis}). This reward cannot be saved.
settings.rewards.refusal.cap: The database refused it: the discount is above the legal cap.
settings.rewards.refusal.amountCap: The database refused it: the amount is above the cap of the minimum bill.
settings.rewards.refusal.retiredFinal: A retired reward cannot be reopened.
settings.rewards.refusal.ownerApproves: Only an owner of every store can approve rewards.
settings.rewards.refusal.noRail: Not activated: a store in scope has no active reward rail.
settings.rewards.refusal.noMapping: Not activated: a store in scope has not mapped this reward to a discount or a 0-price item on the POS.
settings.rewards.refusal.keepsMapping: An active reward keeps its POS mapping at every store; pause the reward first.
settings.rewards.refusal.storeScope: The store list is not valid.
settings.rewards.days.title: Discount days in {year}
settings.rewards.days.info: Information only: the days of the year this reward's items had their selling price reduced, against the limit of {limit} days per item. It never blocks a save.
settings.rewards.days.infoNoLimit: Information only: the days of the year this reward's items had their selling price reduced. The 120-day limit is reported repealed from 26/06/2026 by Decree 239/2026/NĐ-CP; this is still being checked. It never blocks a save.
settings.rewards.days.demo: The demo does not count discount days for the sample rewards.
settings.rewards.days.none: None of this reward's items had a price discount this year.
